controls: Matched formal-lex control: choose the lexicographically least unordered source-index pair inside each identical two-sum output class.
Matched finite null: 31 domain-separated SHA-256 rankings choose one witness independently inside each identical two-sum output class.
Singleton-class diagnostic: report the fraction of output classes where all representative compilers must coincide.
Coordinate-chart diagnostic: preregister a nonzero short-Weierstrass rescaling control before any scale-up.
Independent verifier: separately reconstruct every curve, factor base, witness class, representative table, conflict graph, optimizer certificate, embedding axiom, and witness lift.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Narrow H-SGCP-SECANT-REP-001 if the secant compiler fails to exceed the empirical 95th percentile of the 31 matched hash controls on retained eight-term support for every valid curve, differs from formal-lex on less than 10 percent of nonsingleton witness classes, or fails any exact replay check. Optimizer exhaustion or infrastructure failure is INCONCLUSIVE.
invalidation_rules: Reject singular curves, composite group order, trace 0 or 1, and j-invariant 0 or 1728.
Reject a factor base that is not exactly size 6, sign-complete, duplicate-free, and generated by the frozen random-x rule.
Reject any scalar-index input to a candidate or control compiler.
Reject any mismatch in two-sum output classes or witness multiplicities across candidate and controls.
Reject any failure of injectivity, associativity, unique factorization, acyclicity, final-edge exclusion, or witness lift.
Reject any run without a complete operation, traffic, byte, time, RSS, and optimizer ledger.
Classify optimizer timeout, resource refusal, partial control matrix, or independent-verifier failure as INCONCLUSIVE.

primary: exact retained eight-term support at cap floor(q/2)
candidate percentile among 31 matched hash-ranked representative controls
degree-four conflict edge count at the matched cap
fraction of nonsingleton witness classes where secant and formal-lex representatives differ
secondary: unordered pair enumerations and identity, inverse, secant, and tangent branches
field additions, subtractions, multiplications, squarings, and inversions
SHA-256 calls and input bytes for controls
two-sum support, witness-class multiplicity histogram, and exact four-sum support
representative-table entries and canonical serialized bytes
degree-four candidates, eligible maxima, constrained labels, public edges, and retained maxima
optimizer nodes, bound evaluations, proof nodes, and optimality gap
logical bytes read and written, CPU time, wall time, and externally measured peak RSS

experiment.objective: Test whether actual affine EC line parameters improve recursive structured-group embedding retention through within-output-class witness selection, without changing additive support, witness multiplicity, or optimizer conditions.
required_artifacts: complete operation, traffic, byte, time, RSS, and optimizer ledgers
stopping_rules: Do not execute while maximum_runs is zero or approved_by is null.
Stop before implementation if independent theory or red-team review returns REVISE or NO-GO.
Stop and record INCONCLUSIVE if the exact optimizer cannot prove its result under a future approved resource budget.
Do not promote from one curve or from a singleton-class-dominated matrix.
Do not infer an exponent or ECDLP improvement from this preflight.
experiment.success_criterion: Promote only to a larger coordinate-rescaling and multi-size study if the secant compiler exceeds the empirical 95th percentile of 31 matched hash controls for retained eight-term support on at least two of three valid curves, differs from formal-lex on at least 10 percent of nonsingleton classes, all embedding and witness checks pass, and every charged ledger is independently reproduced. This is a structural preflight, not an ECDLP improvement criterion.
experiment.title: Affine secant-slope representative compiler preflight
